decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed three-bedroom detached dwellinghouse, by reason of its siting and design, would represent an unacceptable form of infill development, which would be detrimental to the residential amenities of the adjoining properties by reason of loss of light, loss of outlook and enclosure, and would fail to provide adequate private amenity space, detrimental to the residential amenity of the occupiers, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1, H.4.1 & H.6.3.

Condition : 2 - The proposed three-bedroom detached dwellinghouse, by reason of its size and position forward of the general building line, would represent an unduly overbearing and obtrusive feature within the streetscene on this prominent corner, and would be detrimental to the visual amenities of the streetscene, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1 & H.6.3.

Condition : 3 - The proposal would fail to provide sufficient off-street parking provision resulting in further on-street parking pressure in this heavily parked road. The proposal would therefore be detrimental to the free flow of traffic and to highway and pedestrian safety, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policy T.1.4.
description: Erection of a detached 3 bedroom dwellinghouse
